# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

**Match the bank to your model:** a 16-inch MacBook Pro fast-charges at 140W, so it needs a USB-C PD 3.1 bank. A 14-inch Pro is fine with 100W. Keep the bank at or under 100Wh so it can go on a plane. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html))

## Top picks

**1. Anker Prime Power Bank (26,250mAh, 300W): best overall**
- Macworld's top pick. It has two 140W USB-C ports and a 99.75Wh battery, which is airline-legal. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html))
- It can fast-charge two MacBooks at once, recharges itself at up to 250W, and has an app. It has no built-in cable, but includes a USB-C cable.
- It lists at $229.99, and Macworld's price tracker showed about $199.98. WIRED also lists it at about $200 on Amazon. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/))

**2. EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W): best with a built-in cable**
- It has a retractable 140W USB-C cable, two 140W ports and two 65W ports. Its 99.54Wh battery is just under the airline limit. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html))
- Expect it to refill a 16-inch Pro to about 70–75%, since some power is lost in transfer.
- It was $219.99 when Macworld reviewed it, and WIRED lists it at about $190 on Amazon. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/))

**3. ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000mAh, 200W): best value at 140W**
- It's about $120 on Amazon, with a built-in 140W cable and a 3-year warranty. It has only one USB-C and one USB-A port, and recharges slowly at 100W max input. ReelCharge is a new brand, so it's a bit riskier. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/))

**4. Baseus Blade H1 (20,000mAh, 100W): budget pick for a 14-inch Pro**
- It's flat and airline-legal at about 74Wh, and includes a 100W cable. Baseus claims 50% in 30 minutes for a MacBook Pro.
- It's $89.99 at Baseus's US store: [buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah). This is an affiliate link, and the page notes per-port power splits aren't published. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah))

## Other options
- **Anker 737 (24,000mAh, 140W, 86.4Wh):** a long-running favorite with a smart display, according to [Laptopbee](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-power-banks-for-macbook-pro/).
- **INIU Cougar P64 (140W):** Macworld's value pick for a 140W bank, though it has low total output. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html))

## My recommendation
- **16-inch Pro:** the Anker Prime 26K, or the EcoFlow RAPID Pro if you want the built-in cable.
- **14-inch Pro on a budget:** the ReelPro or Baseus Blade H1.

For the Anker, EcoFlow and ReelCharge, I only have the review pages above, not direct store links. Search each name on Amazon or the brand's own site to buy. Prices change, so check the current price at checkout.

If you tell me your MacBook Pro size and chip, and whether you'll fly with it, I can narrow this down.
